title.en: Book of Wei, Chapter 16 · Biography of Su Ze

text.en: Fleeing the chaos, Su Ze sought refuge with the wealthy Shi Liang in Anding, who did not treat him as well as he had expected; Su Ze vowed indignantly to return as Grand Administrator and humble such men, and when he did, he sent a messenger to reassure the fearful Shi Liang and treated him with courtesy.
text.zht: 蘇則避亂寄居安定，投靠富人師亮，師亮待他不如所望，蘇則憤然發誓日後必回任太守以折辱此輩；後來他果然出任安定太守，師亮等人懼而欲逃，蘇則遣使安撫，並以禮相待。
text.zhs: 苏则避乱寄居安定，投靠富人师亮，师亮待他不如所望，苏则愤然发誓日后必回任太守以折辱此辈；后来他果然出任安定太守，师亮等人惧而欲逃，苏则遣使安抚，并以礼相待。

text.en: Su Ze withdrew with his fellow townsman Ji Mao to Mount Taibai, where they took delight in their books.
text.zht: 蘇則與同鄉吉茂一同隱居太白山，以讀書為樂。
text.zhs: 苏则与同乡吉茂一同隐居太白山，以读书为乐。

text.en: When Ji Mao mocked him for rising no further than a Palace Attendant who "bears a chamber pot", Su Ze laughed and retorted that he could not match Ji Mao's leisurely rides in a deer cart.
text.zht: 吉茂譏笑蘇則官至侍中不過是「捧虎子」，蘇則笑答自己實在比不上吉茂悠然乘坐鹿車。
text.zhs: 吉茂讥笑苏则官至侍中不过是「捧虎子」，苏则笑答自己实在比不上吉茂悠然乘坐鹿车。

text.en: When Cao Cao campaigned against Zhang Lu he passed through Su Ze's commandery, was pleased on meeting him, and made him guide to the army; Su Ze afterwards pacified the Di of Xiabian, reopened the route West of the River, and was transferred to Grand Administrator of Jincheng, where he restored the shattered population.
text.zht: 曹操徵張魯途經蘇則所在郡，與之相見甚悅，任命他為軍導；張魯敗後，蘇則安撫下辯氐人，重開河西之路，遷任金城太守，安撫戰亂後離散的百姓。
text.zhs: 曹操征张鲁途经苏则所在郡，与之相见甚悦，任命他为军导；张鲁败后，苏则安抚下辩氐人，重开河西之路，迁任金城太守，安抚战乱后离散的百姓。

text.en: When Li Yue rebelled in Longxi, Su Ze led the Qiang and Hu in besieging him, and Li Yue promptly sought to submit.
text.zht: 李越在隴西反叛，蘇則率羌胡圍攻，李越隨即請降。
text.zhs: 李越在陇西反叛，苏则率羌胡围攻，李越随即请降。

text.en: After Cao Cao's death Qu Yan of Xiping rebelled; Su Ze marched against him and Qu Yan begged to surrender, but later rebelled again.
text.zht: 曹操死後西平麴演反叛，蘇則出兵征討，麴演懼敗請降，後又再度反叛。
text.zhs: 曹操死后西平麹演反叛，苏则出兵征讨，麹演惧败请降，后又再度反叛。

text.en: When Qu Yan came with three thousand troops claiming to reinforce him but intending treachery, Su Ze lured him to a meeting, beheaded him, and displayed his head before the troops.
text.zht: 麴演率三千步騎前來，佯稱助戰實懷奸謀，蘇則誘他會面，將其斬首示眾。
text.zhs: 麹演率三千步骑前来，佯称助战实怀奸谋，苏则诱他会面，将其斩首示众。

text.en: Su Ze and the other forces besieged Zhangye and took it, executing Zhang Jin and his supporters.
text.zht: 蘇則與諸軍圍攻張掖，攻克後誅殺張進及其黨羽。
text.zhs: 苏则与诸军围攻张掖，攻克后诛杀张进及其党羽。

text.en: Zhang Jin seized Du Tong, Grand Administrator of his native Zhangye, and proclaimed himself Grand Administrator.
text.zht: 張進擒獲本郡張掖太守杜通，自稱太守。
text.zhs: 张进擒获本郡张掖太守杜通，自称太守。

text.en: Huang Hua refused to acknowledge Xin Ji, Grand Administrator of his native Jiuquan, and proclaimed himself Grand Administrator.
text.zht: 黃華不肯承認本郡酒泉太守辛機，自稱太守。
text.zhs: 黄华不肯承认本郡酒泉太守辛机，自称太守。

text.en: With Qu Yan's army defeated, Huang Hua took fright, released his captives, and begged to surrender, and the lands West of the River were pacified.
text.zht: 麴演軍敗後，黃華恐懼，釋放所俘之人請降，河西遂告平定。
text.zhs: 麹演军败后，黄华恐惧，释放所俘之人请降，河西遂告平定。

text.en: Guanqiu Xing, Grand Administrator of Wuwei, sent Su Ze an urgent appeal for help against the rebels and later joined him in attacking Zhang Jin.
text.zht: 武威太守毌丘興向蘇則急請援助，後又與他聯軍攻打張進。
text.zhs: 武威太守毌丘兴向苏则急请援助，后又与他联军攻打张进。

text.en: Hao Zhao agreed with Su Ze's plan to act on their own authority and raised troops to relieve Wuwei.
text.zht: 郝昭贊同蘇則先發制敵之策，與他一同出兵解武威之圍。
text.zhs: 郝昭赞同苏则先发制敌之策，与他一同出兵解武威之围。

text.en: Wei Ping agreed with Su Ze's plan to act on their own authority and raised troops to relieve Wuwei.
text.zht: 魏平贊同蘇則先發制敵之策，與他一同出兵解武威之圍。
text.zhs: 魏平赞同苏则先发制敌之策，与他一同出兵解武威之围。

text.en: For pacifying Qu Yan, Cao Pi appointed Su Ze Colonel Protecting the Qiang and enfeoffed him as Marquis Within the Pass; Cao Pi also privately sought the Inspector's opinion on raising his rank.
text.zht: 曹丕因蘇則平定麴演之功，任命他為護羌校尉，封關內侯，並私下詢問雍州刺史是否應進其爵邑。
text.zhs: 曹丕因苏则平定麹演之功，任命他为护羌校尉，封关内侯，并私下询问雍州刺史是否应进其爵邑。

text.en: After Su Ze pacified the lands West of the River, he was advanced to Capital Neighbourhood Marquis.
text.zht: 蘇則平定河西后，進封都亭侯。
text.zhs: 苏则平定河西后，进封都亭侯。

text.en: Su Ze told Cao Pi that pearls sought by purchase were not worth prizing and knelt to plead for the hunt officials' lives over an escaped deer; Cao Pi called him an upright minister and pardoned them, but afterwards grew wary of him.
text.zht: 蘇則勸曹丕求購寶珠不足貴，又在獵場逃鹿事件中叩首為眾官請命；曹丕稱他為正直之臣而赦免眾人，此後卻對他心存忌憚。
text.zhs: 苏则劝曹丕求购宝珠不足贵，又在猎场逃鹿事件中叩首为众官请命；曹丕称他为正直之臣而赦免众人，此后却对他心存忌惮。

text.en: In the fourth year of Huangchu, Su Ze was demoted to Principality Chancellor of Dongping and died on the way to his post; he was posthumously titled Marquis Gang.
text.zht: 黃初四年，蘇則被貶為東平相，赴任途中病逝，追諡剛侯。
text.zhs: 黄初四年，苏则被贬为东平相，赴任途中病逝，追谥刚侯。

text.en: Cao Pi consulted Inspector Zhang Ji in confidence about whether Su Ze deserved a higher rank and fief.
text.zht: 曹丕密詢雍州刺史張既，蘇則之功是否應增加爵邑。
text.zhs: 曹丕密询雍州刺史张既，苏则之功是否应增加爵邑。

text.en: Asked for his view, Zhang Ji praised Su Ze for restoring Jincheng's population, winning back the Qiang, and putting down Qu Yan with utmost loyalty, and endorsed raising his rank.
text.zht: 張既奉詢時盛讚蘇則安撫金城遺民、招撫羌人、討平麴演，忠節備至，並贊同增其爵邑。
text.zhs: 张既奉询时盛赞苏则安抚金城遗民、招抚羌人、讨平麹演，忠节备至，并赞同增其爵邑。

text.en: When Dong Zhao laid his head on Su Ze's knees, Su Ze pushed him off, saying his knees were no pillow for a sycophant.
text.zht: 董昭將頭枕在蘇則膝上，蘇則推開他，說自己的膝蓋不是給諂媚之人當枕頭的。
text.zhs: 董昭将头枕在苏则膝上，苏则推开他，说自己的膝盖不是给谄媚之人当枕头的。

text.en: On hearing that Wei had supplanted the Han, Su Ze and Cao Zhi both donned mourning dress and wept bitterly.
text.zht: 聽聞魏代漢，蘇則與曹植都身著喪服，痛哭流涕。
text.zhs: 听闻魏代汉，苏则与曹植都身着丧服，痛哭流涕。

text.en: When Su Ze thought Cao Pi's remark about someone weeping at the abdication was aimed at him and was about to answer forthrightly, Palace Attendant Fu Xun pinched him and signalled that it was not.
text.zht: 曹丕說有人在禪讓時哭泣，蘇則以為指自己，正欲直言相對，侍中傅巽掐他並示意並非說他。
text.zhs: 曹丕说有人在禅让时哭泣，苏则以为指自己，正欲直言相对，侍中傅巽掐他并示意并非说他。

text.en: Su Ze's son Su Yi succeeded him as marquis.
text.zht: 蘇則之子蘇怡襲爵。
text.zhs: 苏则之子苏怡袭爵。

text.en: Su Yi died without a son, so Su Ze's younger son Su Yu inherited the fief and later became Minister of Ceremonies.
text.zht: 蘇怡無子而卒，蘇則次子蘇愉繼承封爵，後官至太常。
text.zhs: 苏怡无子而卒，苏则次子苏愉继承封爵，后官至太常。

text.en: Su Yi died without a son, so his younger brother Su Yu inherited the fief.
text.zht: 蘇怡無子而卒，其弟蘇愉繼承封爵。
text.zhs: 苏怡无子而卒，其弟苏愉继承封爵。

text.en: Su Yu's son Su Shao, courtesy name Shisi, served as tutor to the Prince of Wu.
text.zht: 蘇愉之子蘇紹，字世嗣，曾任吳王師。
text.zhs: 苏愉之子苏绍，字世嗣，曾任吴王师。

text.en: Su Shao's younger brother Su Shen was General of the Central Guards on the Left.
text.zht: 蘇紹之弟蘇慎官至左中郎將。
text.zhs: 苏绍之弟苏慎官至左中郎将。

text.en: Shi Chong's wife was Su Shao's elder sister, making them brothers-in-law.
text.zht: 石崇之妻為蘇紹之姊，二人為姻親。
text.zhs: 石崇之妻为苏绍之姊，二人为姻亲。

text.en: In The Explanation of Matters, Shan Tao praised Su Yu as loyal and steadfast, with sound judgement.
text.zht: 山濤在《啟事》中稱讚蘇愉忠貞堅定，識見明達。
text.zhs: 山涛在《启事》中称赞苏愉忠贞坚定，识见明达。

orig.zht: 蘇則字文師，[[扶風武功|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.24976179&lng=108.02453445&name=Wugong]]人也。少以學行聞，舉孝廉[[茂才|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-flourishing-talent]]，[[辟|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-recruit]]公府，皆不就。[[起|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-reinstate]]家為[[酒泉|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=141]][[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]，[[轉|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-transfer]][[安定|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=152]]、[[武都|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=111]]，所在有威名。
orig.zhs: 苏则字文师，[[扶风武功|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.24976179&lng=108.02453445&name=Wugong]]人也。少以学行闻，举孝廉[[茂才|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-flourishing-talent]]，[[辟|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-recruit]]公府，皆不就。[[起|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-reinstate]]家为[[酒泉|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=141]][[太守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]，[[转|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-transfer]][[安定|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=152]]、[[武都|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=111]]，所在有威名。

vern.zht: 蘇則，字文師，[[扶風郡武功縣|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.24976179&lng=108.02453445&name=Wugong]]人。年少時以學問操行聞名，被舉薦爲孝廉、[[茂才|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-flourishing-talent]]，被公府徵召，他都沒有就任。初入仕途就擔任[[酒泉|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=141]]郡[[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]，轉任[[安定|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=152]][[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]、[[武都|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=111]][[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]，所任職之處都有威名。
vern.zhs: 苏则，字文师，[[扶风郡武功县|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.24976179&lng=108.02453445&name=Wugong]]人。年少时以学问操行闻名，被举荐为孝廉、[[茂才|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-flourishing-talent]]，被公府征召，他都没有就任。初入仕途就担任[[酒泉|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=141]]郡[[太守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]，转任[[安定|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=152]][[太守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]、[[武都|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=111]][[太守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]，所任职之处都有威名。

passages.en: Su Ze, courtesy name Wenshi, was from [[Wugong, Fufeng|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.24976179&lng=108.02453445&name=Wugong]]. As a young man, he was renowned for his learning and conduct. He was nominated as Filial and Incorrupt and as a [[Flourishing Talent|/translations/officials#glossary-flourishing-talent]], and was [[recruited|/translations/officials#glossary-recruit]] to serve in the Excellencies' offices, but declined every appointment. He [[began his official career|/translations/officials#glossary-reinstate]] as [[Grand Administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]] of [[Jiuquan|/maps/map-overall?admin=141]], then [[was transferred|/translations/officials#glossary-transfer]] successively to [[Anding|/maps/map-overall?admin=152]] and [[Wudu|/maps/map-overall?admin=111]]. Wherever he held office, he commanded awe and respect.

annotations.zht: 《魏書》曰：則剛直疾惡，常慕汲黯之為人。
annotations.zhs: 《魏书》曰：则刚直疾恶，常慕汲黯之为人。

vern.zht: 《魏書》記載：蘇則剛直不阿，憎惡邪惡，常常仰慕汲黯的爲人。
vern.zhs: 《魏书》记载：苏则刚直不阿，憎恶邪恶，常常仰慕汲黯的为人。

annotations.en: The Book of Wei states: Su Ze was resolute and upright, and abhorred evil. He often admired Ji An's character.

source.en: Weilüe / Brief History of Wei (Yu Huan)

annotations.zht: 《魏略》曰：則世為著姓，興平中，[[三輔|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-three-capital-regions]]亂，饑窮，避難[[北地|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=143]]。客[[安定|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=152]]，依富室師亮。亮待遇不足，則慨然歎曰：「天下會安，當不乆爾，必還為此郡守，折庸輩士也。」後與[[馮翊|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=151]]吉茂等隱於郡南太白山中，以書籍自娛。及為[[安定|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=152]][[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]，而師亮等皆欲逃走。則聞之，豫使人解語，以禮報之。
annotations.zhs: 《魏略》曰：则世为著姓，兴平中，[[三辅|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-three-capital-regions]]乱，饥穷，避难[[北地|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=143]]。客[[安定|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=152]]，依富室师亮。亮待遇不足，则慨然叹曰：「天下会安，当不乆尔，必还为此郡守，折庸辈士也。」后与[[冯翊|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=151]]吉茂等隐于郡南太白山中，以书籍自娱。及为[[安定|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=152]][[太守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]，而师亮等皆欲逃走。则闻之，豫使人解语，以礼报之。

vern.zht: 《魏略》記載：蘇則家族世代都是名門望族。興平年間，[[三輔|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-three-capital-regions]]地區發生戰亂，蘇則又飢餓又窮困，就去[[北地|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=143]]郡避難，客居在[[安定|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=152]]郡，依附當地的大戶人家師亮生活。師亮對他的待遇不夠好，蘇則感慨地嘆息說：“天下總會[[安定|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=152]]的，時間不會太久了，我一定要回來做這裏的郡守，折服那些平庸的人。”後來他和[[馮翊|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=151]]人吉茂等人一起隱居在[[安定|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=152]]郡南的太白山中，靠讀書來自我娛樂。等到蘇則擔任[[安定|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=152]][[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]時，師亮等人都想逃走，蘇則聽說後，預先派人去解釋開導，以禮相待。
vern.zhs: 《魏略》记载：苏则家族世代都是名门望族。兴平年间，[[三辅|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-three-capital-regions]]地区发生战乱，苏则又饥饿又穷困，就去[[北地|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=143]]郡避难，客居在[[安定|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=152]]郡，依附当地的大户人家师亮生活。师亮对他的待遇不够好，苏则感慨地叹息说：“天下总会[[安定|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=152]]的，时间不会太久了，我一定要回来做这里的郡守，折服那些平庸的人。”后来他和[[冯翊|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=151]]人吉茂等人一起隐居在[[安定|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=152]]郡南的太白山中，靠读书来自我娱乐。等到苏则担任[[安定|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=152]][[太守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]时，师亮等人都想逃走，苏则听说后，预先派人去解释开导，以礼相待。

annotations.en: The Weilüe / Brief History of Wei states: Su Ze came from a family prominent for generations. During the Xingping era, the [[Three Capital Regions|/translations/officials#glossary-three-capital-regions]] descended into chaos and famine, and he fled to [[Beidi|/maps/map-overall?admin=143]]. While sojourning in [[Anding|/maps/map-overall?admin=152]], he sought refuge with a wealthy man named Shi Liang, who did not treat him as well as he had expected. Su Ze sighed indignantly, "Peace will soon be restored throughout the realm. I shall surely return as [[Grand Administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]] of this commandery and humble such mediocrities." He later withdrew with Ji Mao of [[Pingyi|/maps/map-overall?admin=151]] and others to Mount Taibai, south of the commandery, where they took delight in their books. When Su Ze became Grand Administrator of [[Anding|/maps/map-overall?admin=152]], Shi Liang and the others all sought to flee. Hearing of this, Su Ze sent a messenger to reassure them and treated them with courtesy.

orig.zht: 太祖征張魯，過其郡，見則恱之，使為軍導。魯破，則綏安[[下辯|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=33.80983291&lng=105.64254196&name=Xiabian]]諸氐，通[[河西|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-west-of-the-river-hexi-heyou]]道，徙為[[金城|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=139]][[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]。是時喪亂之後，吏民流散饑窮，戶口損耗，則撫循之甚謹。外招懷羌胡，得其牛羊，以養貧老。與民分糧而食，旬月之閒，流民皆歸，得數千家。乃明為禁令，有干犯者輒戮，其從教者必賞。親自教民耕種，其歲大豐收，由是歸附者日多。
orig.zhs: 太祖征张鲁，过其郡，见则恱之，使为军导。鲁破，则绥安[[下辩|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=33.80983291&lng=105.64254196&name=Xiabian]]诸氐，通[[河西|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-west-of-the-river-hexi-heyou]]道，徙为[[金城|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=139]][[太守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]。是时丧乱之后，吏民流散饥穷，户口损耗，则抚循之甚谨。外招怀羌胡，得其牛羊，以养贫老。与民分粮而食，旬月之闲，流民皆归，得数千家。乃明为禁令，有干犯者辄戮，其从教者必赏。亲自教民耕种，其岁大丰收，由是归附者日多。

vern.zhs: 太祖征讨张鲁，经过苏则所在的郡，见到苏则后很喜欢他，让他担任军中向导。张鲁被击败后，苏则安抚[[下辩|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=33.80983291&lng=105.64254196&name=Xiabian]]一带各部氐人，打通了[[河西|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-west-of-the-river-hexi-heyou]]道，调任[[金城|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=139]][[太守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]。当时正值丧乱之后，官吏百姓流离失所，饥饿贫穷，户口减少，苏则安抚照顾他们十分谨慎周到。对外招纳安抚羌胡，得到他们的牛羊，用来赡养贫穷老人。他和百姓分粮而食，一个月左右的时间里，流民便都回来了，共有数千家。于是苏则明确制定禁令，有触犯禁令的就处死，听从教导的一定奖赏。他亲自教百姓耕种，当年获得大丰收，从此归附的人日益增多。

passages.en: When Cao Cao (posthumously honoured as Taizu, the Grand Progenitor) campaigned against Zhang Lu, he passed through Su Ze's commandery. Cao Cao was pleased upon meeting Su Ze, appointing him as guide to the army. After Zhang Lu was defeated, Su Ze pacified the Di tribes of [[Xiabian|/maps/map-overall?lat=33.80983291&lng=105.64254196&name=Xiabian]] and re-established the route [[West of the River|/translations/officials#glossary-west-of-the-river-hexi-heyou]]. He was then relocated to serve as [[Grand Administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]] of [[Jincheng|/maps/map-overall?admin=139]]. In the aftermath of war and disorder, officials and commoners had scattered, famine and destitution were rife, and the population had sharply declined. Su Ze tended the people with great care. He won over the Qiang and Hu peoples, obtaining cattle and sheep from them to support the poor and elderly. He also shared grain with the people, and within a month the displaced had all returned, amounting to several thousand households. Su Ze then clearly proclaimed laws and prohibitions. Those who violated them were summarily executed, while those who obeyed were invariably rewarded. He personally taught the people to till and sow, and that year the harvest was abundant. From then on, those who came to submit grew by the day.

vern.zht: 李越據[[隴西|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=150]]反叛，蘇則率領羌胡包圍李越，李越立即請求歸附。太祖去世後，[[西平|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=140]]麴演反叛，自稱[[護羌校尉|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#colonels--commandants-189]]。蘇則領兵討伐他，麴演恐懼，請求投降。文帝因蘇則的功勞，加授蘇則爲[[護羌校尉|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#colonels--commandants-189]]，賜[[關內侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-marquis-within-the-pass]]爵位。後來麴演又聯合鄰近的郡作亂，[[張掖|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=137]]的張進捉拿了[[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]杜通，[[酒泉|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=141]]的黃華不接受[[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]辛機，張進、黃華都自稱[[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]來響應他。此外，[[武威|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=138]]的三種胡人一起侵擾劫掠，道路斷絕。[[武威|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=138]][[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]毌丘興向蘇則告急。
vern.zhs: 李越据[[陇西|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=150]]反叛，苏则率领羌胡包围李越，李越立即请求归附。太祖去世后，[[西平|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=140]]麹演反叛，自称[[护羌校尉|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#colonels--commandants-189]]。苏则领兵讨伐他，麹演恐惧，请求投降。文帝因苏则的功劳，加授苏则为[[护羌校尉|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#colonels--commandants-189]]，赐[[关内侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-marquis-within-the-pass]]爵位。后来麹演又联合邻近的郡作乱，[[张掖|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=137]]的张进捉拿了[[太守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]杜通，[[酒泉|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=141]]的黄华不接受[[太守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]辛机，张进、黄华都自称[[太守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]来响应他。此外，[[武威|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=138]]的三种胡人一起侵扰劫掠，道路断绝。[[武威|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=138]][[太守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]毌丘兴向苏则告急。

passages.en: When Li Yue rebelled in [[Longxi|/maps/map-overall?admin=150]], Su Ze led the Qiang and Hu in laying siege to him, and Li Yue promptly sought to submit. After Cao Cao's death, Qu Yan of [[Xiping|/maps/map-overall?admin=140]] rebelled and proclaimed himself [[Colonel Protecting the Qiang|/translations/officials/military#colonels--commandants-189]]. Su Ze mustered his troops and marched against him. Fearing defeat, Qu Yan begged to surrender. In recognition of Ze's achievement, Cao Pi (posthumously honoured as Emperor Wen, the Civil Emperor) appointed him [[Colonel Protecting the Qiang|/translations/officials/military#colonels--commandants-189]] and enfeoffed him as [[Marquis Within the Pass|/translations/officials#glossary-marquis-within-the-pass]]. Later, Qu Yan again joined with neighbouring commanderies in rebellion. Zhang Jin seized Du Tong, [[Grand Administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]] of his native [[Zhangye|/maps/map-overall?admin=137]], while Huang Hua refused to acknowledge Xin Ji, [[Grand Administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]] of his native [[Jiuquan|/maps/map-overall?admin=141]]. Zhang Jin and Huang Hua each proclaimed himself [[Grand Administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]] and rallied to Qu Yan. Three Hu tribes from [[Wuwei|/maps/map-overall?admin=138]] also began raiding and plundering, severing the roads. Guanqiu Xing, [[Grand Administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]] of [[Wuwei|/maps/map-overall?admin=138]], sent an urgent appeal to Su Ze.

vern.zht: 《魏名臣奏》記載，魏文帝下詔詢問[[雍州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=14]][[刺史|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]]張既說：“暫代[[金城|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=139]][[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]的蘇則，既有安撫百姓、平定夷族的功勞，又聽說他出兵向[[西平|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=140]]定了湟中，爲[[河西|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-west-of-the-river-hexi-heyou]]地區造出聲勢，我十分讚賞他。蘇則的功績和成效，是否可以增加他的爵位和封邑呢？封爵是重要的事情，所以我來問你，你要祕密地告訴我你的看法，先不要對外泄露這件事。”張既回答說：“[[金城|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=139]]郡過去被韓遂屠殺洗劫，百姓死亡、逃亡，有的逃奔戎狄部落，有的陷入賊寇動亂中，戶口不足五百。蘇則到任後，對內安撫遭受戰亂創傷的百姓，對外聚集離散的民衆，如今現有的民戶已達一千多戶。另外，梁覺等混雜的羌人部落，過去曾與韓遂一同作惡，於是消滅了他們。後來，他們越過邊塞，蘇則前後招撫懷柔，歸附到郡中的有三千多部落，蘇則都用威嚴和恩德去體恤他們，讓他們爲官府效力。[[西平|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=140]]的麴演等人陰謀起事，蘇則立即出兵兵臨其要害之地，麴演馬上投降並送來人質，蘇則還斷絕了叛賊的糧草。蘇則既有撫卹百姓的功效，又能與戎狄和睦相處，竭盡忠誠，恪守節操，遇到聖明的君主，有功勞必定會被記錄。如果給蘇則增加爵位和封邑，確實足以勸勉忠臣，激勵社會風氣。”
vern.zhs: 《魏名臣奏》记载，魏文帝下诏询问[[雍州|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=14]][[刺史|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]]张既说：“暂代[[金城|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=139]][[太守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]的苏则，既有安抚百姓、平定夷族的功劳，又听说他出兵向[[西平|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=140]]定了湟中，为[[河西|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-west-of-the-river-hexi-heyou]]地区造出声势，我十分赞赏他。苏则的功绩和成效，是否可以增加他的爵位和封邑呢？封爵是重要的事情，所以我来问你，你要秘密地告诉我你的看法，先不要对外泄露这件事。”张既回答说：“[[金城|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=139]]郡过去被韩遂屠杀洗劫，百姓死亡、逃亡，有的逃奔戎狄部落，有的陷入贼寇动乱中，户口不足五百。苏则到任后，对内安抚遭受战乱创伤的百姓，对外聚集离散的民众，如今现有的民户已达一千多户。另外，梁觉等混杂的羌人部落，过去曾与韩遂一同作恶，于是消灭了他们。后来，他们越过边塞，苏则前后招抚怀柔，归附到郡中的有三千多部落，苏则都用威严和恩德去体恤他们，让他们为官府效力。[[西平|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=140]]的麹演等人阴谋起事，苏则立即出兵兵临其要害之地，麹演马上投降并送来人质，苏则还断绝了叛贼的粮草。苏则既有抚恤百姓的功效，又能与戎狄和睦相处，竭尽忠诚，恪守节操，遇到圣明的君主，有功劳必定会被记录。如果给苏则增加爵位和封邑，确实足以劝勉忠臣，激励社会风气。”

annotations.en: The Memorials of Renowned Ministers of Wei records: Cao Pi issued an order asking Zhang Ji, [[Inspector|/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]] of [[Yong Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=14]]: "Su Ze, [[probationary|/translations/officials#glossary-interim]] [[Grand Administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]] of [[Jincheng|/maps/map-overall?admin=139]], has already earned merit by pacifying the people and subduing the Yi. I hear that he has also led troops west to pacify Huangzhong, thereby bolstering our position [[West of the River|/translations/officials#glossary-west-of-the-river-hexi-heyou]]. I greatly commend him. Do Su Ze's achievements warrant an increase in noble rank and fief? The conferral of titles is a weighty matter, so I ask your opinion. Report your views in confidence, and do not disclose them for the present." Zhang Ji replied: "[[Jincheng|/maps/map-overall?admin=139]] Commandery was once slaughtered and despoiled by Han Sui. Its people were killed or driven into exile. Some fled to the Rong and Di, while others were engulfed by rebellion and disorder. Fewer than five hundred households remained. When Su Ze took office, he comforted the ravaged survivors within the commandery and gathered in those scattered beyond it. There are now more than a thousand registered households. Moreover, the Qiang tribes of Liangshao had formerly joined Han Sui in wrongdoing and, after his death, fled beyond the frontier barriers. Su Ze repeatedly summoned and conciliated them, and more than three thousand tribes returned to settle in the commandery. He governed them all with authority and benevolence, and they rendered service to the state. When Qu Yan of [[Xiping|/maps/map-overall?admin=140]] and others hatched a treacherous plot, Su Ze promptly sent out troops and bore down upon them. Qu Yan submitted and sent hostages, while Su Ze destroyed and cut off the rebels' supplies. Su Ze not only relieved the people, but also brought harmony to the Rong and Di, displaying the utmost loyalty and integrity. Under an enlightened sovereign, merit is certain to be recognised. To increase Su Ze's noble rank and fief would indeed encourage loyal ministers and improve the customs of the age."

orig.zht: 時[[雍|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=14]]、[[涼|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=5]]諸豪皆驅略羌胡以從進等，郡人咸以為進不可當。又將軍郝昭、魏平先是各屯守[[金城|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=139]]，亦受詔不得西度。則乃見郡中大吏及昭等與羌豪帥謀曰：「今賊雖盛，然皆新合，或有脅從，未必同心；因釁擊之，善惡必離，離而歸我，我增而彼損矣。旣獲益衆之實，且有倍氣之勢，率以進討，破之必矣。若待大軍，曠日持乆，善人無歸，必合於惡，善惡旣合，勢難卒離。雖有詔命，違而合權，專之可也。」
orig.zhs: 时[[雍|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=14]]、[[凉|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=5]]诸豪皆驱略羌胡以从进等，郡人咸以为进不可当。又将军郝昭、魏平先是各屯守[[金城|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=139]]，亦受诏不得西度。则乃见郡中大吏及昭等与羌豪帅谋曰：「今贼虽盛，然皆新合，或有胁从，未必同心；因衅击之，善恶必离，离而归我，我增而彼损矣。既获益众之实，且有倍气之势，率以进讨，破之必矣。若待大军，旷日持乆，善人无归，必合于恶，善恶既合，势难卒离。虽有诏命，违而合权，专之可也。」

vern.zht: 當時[[雍|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=14]]州、[[涼|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=5]]州的各個豪強都驅趕、劫掠羌人、胡人，讓他們跟隨張進等人；郡中的人都認爲張進不可抵擋。另外，將軍郝昭、魏平此前各自屯守[[金城|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=139]]，也接到詔命不得向西進兵。蘇則於是會見郡中的主要官員和郝昭等人，與羌人首領們商議說：“現在賊人雖然強盛，但都是剛剛聚合起來的，其中有人是受脅迫跟從的，未必一條心；利用他們的嫌隙去攻打他們，善惡必定分離，善者分離出來歸附我們，我方增加而敵方減損。既獲得兵力增多的實利，又有士氣倍增的氣勢，率領軍隊進兵討伐，必定能擊破他們。如果等待大軍，曠日持久，善人沒有歸附之處，必然與惡人合到一起；善惡既已合到一起，形勢就難以驟然分開。雖然有詔命，但違背它而合乎權變，自行決斷是可以的。”
vern.zhs: 当时[[雍|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=14]]州、[[凉|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=5]]州的各个豪强都驱赶、劫掠羌人、胡人，让他们跟随张进等人；郡中的人都认为张进不可抵挡。另外，将军郝昭、魏平此前各自屯守[[金城|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=139]]，也接到诏命不得向西进兵。苏则于是会见郡中的主要官员和郝昭等人，与羌人首领们商议说：“现在贼人虽然强盛，但都是刚刚聚合起来的，其中有人是受胁迫跟从的，未必一条心；利用他们的嫌隙去攻打他们，善恶必定分离，善者分离出来归附我们，我方增加而敌方减损。既获得兵力增多的实利，又有士气倍增的气势，率领军队进兵讨伐，必定能击破他们。如果等待大军，旷日持久，善人没有归附之处，必然与恶人合到一起；善恶既已合到一起，形势就难以骤然分开。虽然有诏命，但违背它而合乎权变，自行决断是可以的。”

passages.en: At the time, the powerful clans of [[Yong Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=14]] and [[Liang Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=5]] were all seizing Qiang and Hu tribesmen and compelling them to join Zhang Jin and his followers. The people of the commandery believed Zhang Jin could not be withstood. Furthermore, the generals Hao Zhao and Wei Ping had previously been stationed separately at [[Jincheng|/maps/map-overall?admin=139]] and were also ordered not to cross westwards. Su Ze therefore met with the commandery's senior officials, Hao Zhao and the others, and the Qiang chieftains, and said: "Though the rebels are now strong, they have only recently banded together. Some were coerced into joining them, and they are unlikely to be of one mind. If we exploit an opening and attack, the good and the wicked will surely part. The good will then come over to us, swelling our numbers while diminishing theirs. With our forces enlarged and our spirit doubled, we can lead them against the rebels and are certain to prevail. But if we wait for the main army, the conflict will be prolonged. With nowhere else to turn, the good will inevitably join the wicked. Once they have joined together, it will be difficult to separate them swiftly. Though acting now would contravene the imperial command, it is justified by expediency. We should therefore act on our own authority."

orig.zht: 於是昭等從之，乃發兵救[[武威|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=138]]，降其三種胡，與興擊進於[[張掖|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=137]]。演聞之，將步騎三千迎則，辭來助軍，而實欲為變。則誘與相見，因斬之，出以徇軍，其黨皆散走。則遂與諸軍圍[[張掖|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=137]]，破之，斬進及其支黨，衆皆降。演軍敗，華懼，出所執乞降，[[河西|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-west-of-the-river-hexi-heyou]]平。乃還[[金城|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=139]]。進封[[都亭侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]，邑三百戶。
orig.zhs: 于是昭等从之，乃发兵救[[武威|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=138]]，降其三种胡，与兴击进于[[张掖|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=137]]。演闻之，将步骑三千迎则，辞来助军，而实欲为变。则诱与相见，因斩之，出以徇军，其党皆散走。则遂与诸军围[[张掖|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=137]]，破之，斩进及其支党，众皆降。演军败，华惧，出所执乞降，[[河西|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-west-of-the-river-hexi-heyou]]平。乃还[[金城|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=139]]。进封[[都亭侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]，邑三百户。

vern.zht: 於是郝昭等人聽從了蘇則的意見，發兵救援[[武威|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=138]]，降服了當地的三種胡人，並與毌丘興在[[張掖|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=137]]攻打張進。麴演聽說後，率領三千步兵、騎兵來迎接蘇則，聲稱是來幫助軍隊，實際卻想趁機作亂。蘇則引誘他前來相見，趁機將他斬首，並把首級在軍中示衆，他的黨羽都四散逃走。蘇則隨後與各軍包圍[[張掖|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=137]]，攻破城池，斬殺張進及其黨羽，其餘部衆全部投降。麴演的軍隊戰敗，黃華恐懼，交出自己所扣押的人乞求投降，[[河西|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-west-of-the-river-hexi-heyou]]因此平定。蘇則於是回到[[金城|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=139]]，進封爲[[都亭侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]，食邑三百戶。
vern.zhs: 于是郝昭等人听从了苏则的意见，发兵救援[[武威|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=138]]，降服了当地的三种胡人，并与毌丘兴在[[张掖|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=137]]攻打张进。麹演听说后，率领三千步兵、骑兵来迎接苏则，声称是来帮助军队，实际却想趁机作乱。苏则引诱他前来相见，趁机将他斩首，并把首级在军中示众，他的党羽都四散逃走。苏则随后与各军包围[[张掖|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=137]]，攻破城池，斩杀张进及其党羽，其余部众全部投降。麹演的军队战败，黄华恐惧，交出自己所扣押的人乞求投降，[[河西|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-west-of-the-river-hexi-heyou]]因此平定。苏则于是回到[[金城|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=139]]，进封为[[都亭侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]，食邑三百户。

passages.en: Hao Zhao and the others agreed. They then raised troops to relieve [[Wuwei|/maps/map-overall?admin=138]], secured the surrender of the three Hu tribes, and joined Guanqiu Xing in attacking Zhang Jin at [[Zhangye|/maps/map-overall?admin=137]]. Hearing of this, Qu Yan led three thousand infantry and cavalry to meet Su Ze, claiming that he had come to reinforce the army, though he in fact intended treachery. Su Ze lured him to a meeting, beheaded him, and displayed his head before the troops. Qu Yan's followers scattered and fled. Su Ze and the other forces then besieged [[Zhangye|/maps/map-overall?admin=137]] and took it, executing Zhang Jin and his supporters. The rest of the rebels all surrendered. With Qu Yan's army defeated, Huang Hua took fright, released his captives, and begged to surrender. The lands [[West of the River|/translations/officials#glossary-west-of-the-river-hexi-heyou]] were thus pacified, and Su Ze returned to [[Jincheng|/maps/map-overall?admin=139]]. He was advanced to [[Capital Neighbourhood Marquis|/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]], with a fief of three hundred households.

orig.zht: [[徵|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-summon]][[拜|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-formally-appoint]][[侍中|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-001]]，與董昭同寮。昭嘗枕則膝卧，則推下之，曰：「蘇則之膝，非佞人之枕也。」初，則及[[臨菑侯|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.88984425&lng=118.33708136&name=Linzi]]植聞魏氏代漢，皆發服悲哭，文帝聞植如此，而不聞則也。帝在[[洛陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.69341538&lng=112.5823423&name=Luoyang]]，嘗從容言曰：「吾應天而禪，而聞有哭者，何也？」則謂為見問，鬚髯悉張，欲正論以對。[[侍中|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-001]]傅巽掐則曰：「不謂卿也。」於是乃止。
orig.zhs: [[征|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-summon]][[拜|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-formally-appoint]][[侍中|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-001]]，与董昭同寮。昭尝枕则膝卧，则推下之，曰：「苏则之膝，非佞人之枕也。」初，则及[[临菑侯|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=36.88984425&lng=118.33708136&name=Linzi]]植闻魏氏代汉，皆发服悲哭，文帝闻植如此，而不闻则也。帝在[[洛阳|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.69341538&lng=112.5823423&name=Luoyang]]，尝从容言曰：「吾应天而禅，而闻有哭者，何也？」则谓为见问，须髯悉张，欲正论以对。[[侍中|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-001]]傅巽掐则曰：「不谓卿也。」于是乃止。

vern.zht: 蘇則被徵召，[[拜|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-formally-appoint]]爲[[侍中|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-001]]，與董昭爲同僚。董昭曾經枕着蘇則的膝蓋躺臥，蘇則把他推下去，說：“蘇則的膝蓋，不是諂媚逢迎之人的枕頭。”當初，蘇則和[[臨菑侯|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.88984425&lng=118.33708136&name=Linzi]]曹植聽說魏氏取代了漢朝，都穿上喪服悲傷哭泣；文帝聽說曹植這樣，卻沒有聽說蘇則也這樣。文帝在[[洛陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.69341538&lng=112.5823423&name=Luoyang]]，曾從容地說：“我順應天命接受禪讓，卻聽說有人哭泣，爲什麼？”蘇則以爲是在問自己，鬍鬚全都豎了起來，想以嚴正的議論回答。[[侍中|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-001]]傅巽掐了蘇則一下，說：“不是說您。”蘇則這才作罷。
vern.zhs: 苏则被征召，[[拜|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-formally-appoint]]为[[侍中|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-001]]，与董昭为同僚。董昭曾经枕着苏则的膝盖躺卧，苏则把他推下去，说：“苏则的膝盖，不是谄媚逢迎之人的枕头。”当初，苏则和[[临菑侯|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=36.88984425&lng=118.33708136&name=Linzi]]曹植听说魏氏取代了汉朝，都穿上丧服悲伤哭泣；文帝听说曹植这样，却没有听说苏则也这样。文帝在[[洛阳|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.69341538&lng=112.5823423&name=Luoyang]]，曾从容地说：“我顺应天命接受禅让，却听说有人哭泣，为什么？”苏则以为是在问自己，胡须全都竖了起来，想以严正的议论回答。[[侍中|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-001]]傅巽掐了苏则一下，说：“不是说您。”苏则这才作罢。

passages.en: Thereafter, Su Ze was [[summoned|/translations/officials#glossary-summon]] and [[appointed|/translations/officials#glossary-formally-appoint]] [[Palace Attendant|/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-001]], serving alongside Dong Zhao. Dong Zhao once laid his head on Su Ze's knees. Su Ze pushed him off, saying, "Su Ze's knees are no pillow for a sycophant." When Su Ze and Marquis of [[Linzi|/maps/map-overall?lat=36.88984425&lng=118.33708136&name=Linzi]], Cao Zhi, first heard that Wei had supplanted the Han, both donned mourning dress and wept bitterly. Cao Pi heard of Cao Zhi's conduct, but not Su Ze's. Once, while in [[Luoyang|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.69341538&lng=112.5823423&name=Luoyang]], the emperor casually remarked, "I accepted the abdication in accordance with Heaven, yet I hear that someone wept. Why was that?" Su Ze thought the question was addressed to him. His beard bristled, and he was about to answer with a forthright remonstrance when the [[Palace Attendant|/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-001]] Fu Xun pinched him and said, "His Majesty was not referring to you." Su Ze then desisted.

annotations.zht: 《魏略》曰：舊儀，[[侍中|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-001]]親省起居，故俗謂之執虎子。始則同郡吉茂者，是時仕甫歷[[縣令|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#counties-088]]，[[遷|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-reassign]]為宂散。茂見則，嘲之曰：「仕進不止執虎子。」則笑曰：「我誠不能效汝蹇蹇驅鹿車馳也。」初，則在[[金城|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=139]]，聞漢帝禪位，以為崩也，乃發喪；後聞其在，自以不審，意頗默然。[[臨菑|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.88984425&lng=118.33708136&name=Linzi]]侯植自傷失先帝意，亦怨激而哭。其後文帝出游，追恨臨菑，顧謂左右曰：「人心不同，當我登大位之時，天下有哭者。」時從臣知帝此言，有為而發也，而則以為為己，欲下馬謝。[[侍中|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-001]]傅巽目之，乃悟。
annotations.zhs: 《魏略》曰：旧仪，[[侍中|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-001]]亲省起居，故俗谓之执虎子。始则同郡吉茂者，是时仕甫历[[县令|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#counties-088]]，[[迁|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-reassign]]为宂散。茂见则，嘲之曰：「仕进不止执虎子。」则笑曰：「我诚不能效汝蹇蹇驱鹿车驰也。」初，则在[[金城|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=139]]，闻汉帝禅位，以为崩也，乃发丧；后闻其在，自以不审，意颇默然。[[临菑|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=36.88984425&lng=118.33708136&name=Linzi]]侯植自伤失先帝意，亦怨激而哭。其后文帝出游，追恨临菑，顾谓左右曰：「人心不同，当我登大位之时，天下有哭者。」时从臣知帝此言，有为而发也，而则以为为己，欲下马谢。[[侍中|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-001]]傅巽目之，乃悟。

vern.zht: 《魏略》記載：按照故舊禮儀，[[侍中|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-001]]要親自照料皇帝的起居，所以民間把他們稱爲“執虎子”。起初，蘇則的同郡人吉茂，當時剛剛擔任過[[縣令|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#counties-088]]，遷任爲散職官員。吉茂見到蘇則，就嘲笑他說：“你當官一直升卻還是執虎子啊！”蘇則笑道：“我確實不能效仿你慢慢地趕着鹿車啊！”當初，蘇則在[[金城|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=139]]時，聽說漢帝禪讓皇位，以爲漢帝駕崩了，於是爲漢帝發喪。後來聽說他還活着，自認爲沒有弄清楚情況，很是沉默不語。[[臨菑|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.88984425&lng=118.33708136&name=Linzi]]侯曹植爲自己失去曹操的寵愛而傷心，也因怨恨激動而哭泣。後來魏文帝出遊，追恨[[臨菑|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.88984425&lng=118.33708136&name=Linzi]]侯，回頭對左右的人說：“人心各不相同，當我登上皇位的時候，天下有哭泣的人。”當時隨從羣臣都知道文帝這番話心有所指。而蘇則以爲是在說自己，欲下馬謝罪，[[侍中|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-001]]傅巽用眼神示意他，他才醒悟過來。
vern.zhs: 《魏略》记载：按照故旧礼仪，[[侍中|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-001]]要亲自照料皇帝的起居，所以民间把他们称为“执虎子”。起初，苏则的同郡人吉茂，当时刚刚担任过[[县令|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#counties-088]]，迁任为散职官员。吉茂见到苏则，就嘲笑他说：“你当官一直升却还是执虎子啊！”苏则笑道：“我确实不能效仿你慢慢地赶着鹿车啊！”当初，苏则在[[金城|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=139]]时，听说汉帝禅让皇位，以为汉帝驾崩了，于是为汉帝发丧。后来听说他还活着，自认为没有弄清楚情况，很是沉默不语。[[临菑|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=36.88984425&lng=118.33708136&name=Linzi]]侯曹植为自己失去曹操的宠爱而伤心，也因怨恨激动而哭泣。后来魏文帝出游，追恨[[临菑|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=36.88984425&lng=118.33708136&name=Linzi]]侯，回头对左右的人说：“人心各不相同，当我登上皇位的时候，天下有哭泣的人。”当时随从群臣都知道文帝这番话心有所指。而苏则以为是在说自己，欲下马谢罪，[[侍中|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-001]]傅巽用眼神示意他，他才醒悟过来。

annotations.en: The Weilüe / Brief History of Wei states: Under the conventional rites system, the [[Palace Attendant|/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-001]] personally attended to the emperor's daily needs, and was therefore commonly referred to as "the chamber-pot bearer". At first, Ji Mao, a man of Sun Ze's home commandery, had only just served as a [[County Magistrate|/translations/officials/regional#counties-088]] before being [[reassigned|/translations/officials#glossary-reassign]] to a supernumerary post. On seeing Sun Ze, Ji Mao mocked him: "Your advancement in office has brought you no further than bearing a chamber pot." Su Ze laughed and replied, "I truly cannot emulate you, riding leisurely about in a deer cart." Earlier, while in [[Jincheng|/maps/map-overall?admin=139]], Su Ze had heard that the Han emperor abdicated the throne and mistakenly believed that he had died, so he went into mourning. When he later learnt that the emperor was still alive, he reproached himself for not having ascertained the truth and became markedly subdued. The Marquis of [[Linzi|/maps/map-overall?lat=36.88984425&lng=118.33708136&name=Linzi]], Cao Zhi, grieved that he had lost Cao Cao's favour, had also wept in bitter anguish. Later, while Cao Pi was out on an excursion, he recalled Cao Zhi with resentment and turned to his attendants, saying, "Men's hearts differ. When I ascended the throne, there were those in the empire who wept." The accompanying ministers understood that the emperor's remark was directed at someone in particular. Su Ze thought it referred to him and was about to dismount and apologise. The [[Palace Attendant|/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-001]] Fu Xun signalled to Su Ze with his eyes, and only then did Su Ze understand that the remark was not directed at him.

annotations.zht: 孫盛曰：夫士不事其所非，不非其所事，趣舍出處，而豈徒哉！則旣策名新朝，委質異代，而方懷二心生忿，欲奮爽言，豈大雅君子去就之分哉？詩云：「士也罔極，二三其德。」士之二三，猶喪妃偶，況人臣乎？
annotations.zhs: 孙盛曰：夫士不事其所非，不非其所事，趣舍出处，而岂徒哉！则既策名新朝，委质异代，而方怀二心生忿，欲奋爽言，岂大雅君子去就之分哉？诗云：「士也罔极，二三其德。」士之二三，犹丧妃偶，况人臣乎？

vern.zht: 孫盛說：士人不侍奉自己認爲不對的君主，不非議自己所侍奉的君主，他們的取捨進退，難道是沒有原因的嗎？則既然已經在新朝出仕爲官，向新的君主稱臣效忠，卻還心懷二心，心生怨憤想要痛快地說出不滿之言，這難道是大雅君子在去留問題上應有的操守嗎！《詩經》說：“士人沒有準則，德行反覆無常。”士人反覆無常，尚且會失去配偶，何況是作爲臣子呢？
vern.zhs: 孙盛说：士人不侍奉自己认为不对的君主，不非议自己所侍奉的君主，他们的取舍进退，难道是没有原因的吗？则既然已经在新朝出仕为官，向新的君主称臣效忠，却还心怀二心，心生怨愤想要痛快地说出不满之言，这难道是大雅君子在去留问题上应有的操守吗！《诗经》说：“士人没有准则，德行反复无常。”士人反复无常，尚且会失去配偶，何况是作为臣子呢？

annotations.en: Sun Sheng remarked: A gentleman does not serve one he condemns, nor condemn one he serves. His decisions to give or withdraw his allegiance, to take office or retire, are surely not made lightly. Yet having entered his name on the rolls of a new court and pledged his service to another dynasty, he still harboured divided loyalties, grew resentful, and sought to vent his feelings through outspoken criticism. Is this truly the principle a noble gentleman should uphold when choosing whether to remain or withdraw? The Odes states, "You know no constancy; fickle is your conduct". A man's fickleness may cost him his spouse; how much more so for a minister?

orig.zht: 文帝問則曰：「前破[[酒泉|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=141]]、[[張掖|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=137]]，西域通使，燉煌獻徑[[寸|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-cun]]大珠，可復求市益得不？」則對曰：「若陛下化洽中國，德流沙漠，即不求自至；求而得之，不足貴也。」帝嘿然。後則從行獵，槎桎拔，失鹿，帝大怒，踞胡牀拔刀，悉收督吏，將斬之。則稽首曰：「臣聞古之聖王不以禽獸害人，今陛下方隆唐堯之化，而以獵戲多殺羣吏，愚臣以為不可。敢以死請！」帝曰：「卿，直臣也。」遂皆赦之。然以此見憚。
orig.zhs: 文帝问则曰：「前破[[酒泉|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=141]]、[[张掖|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=137]]，西域通使，炖煌献径[[寸|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-cun]]大珠，可复求市益得不？」则对曰：「若陛下化洽中国，德流沙漠，即不求自至；求而得之，不足贵也。」帝嘿然。后则从行猎，槎桎拔，失鹿，帝大怒，踞胡床拔刀，悉收督吏，将斩之。则稽首曰：「臣闻古之圣王不以禽兽害人，今陛下方隆唐尧之化，而以猎戏多杀群吏，愚臣以为不可。敢以死请！」帝曰：「卿，直臣也。」遂皆赦之。然以此见惮。

vern.zht: 文帝問蘇則說：“此前攻破[[酒泉|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=141]]、[[張掖|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=137]]，與西域互通使節，敦煌獻上直徑一[[寸|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-cun]]的大珠，還能再求購到更多嗎？”蘇則回答說：“如果陛下的教化普及中原，德行流佈到沙漠，那麼這些不用求取也會自己到來；靠求取才得到的，就不值得珍貴。”文帝默然不語。後來蘇則隨從文帝出行打獵，圍獵的柵欄被拔掉，鹿逃走了，文帝大怒，坐在胡牀上拔出刀，把督吏全部收捕，準備斬殺他們。蘇則叩頭說：“臣聽說古代的聖王不因禽獸而傷害人，如今陛下正尊崇唐堯的教化，卻因爲打獵的遊戲要殺害衆多官吏，愚臣認爲不可以。斗膽以死相請！”文帝說：“你是正直的臣子。”於是把他們全部赦免了。然而蘇則也因此被文帝忌憚。
vern.zhs: 文帝问苏则说：“此前攻破[[酒泉|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=141]]、[[张掖|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=137]]，与西域互通使节，敦煌献上直径一[[寸|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-cun]]的大珠，还能再求购到更多吗？”苏则回答说：“如果陛下的教化普及中原，德行流布到沙漠，那么这些不用求取也会自己到来；靠求取才得到的，就不值得珍贵。”文帝默然不语。后来苏则随从文帝出行打猎，围猎的栅栏被拔掉，鹿逃走了，文帝大怒，坐在胡床上拔出刀，把督吏全部收捕，准备斩杀他们。苏则叩头说：“臣听说古代的圣王不因禽兽而伤害人，如今陛下正尊崇唐尧的教化，却因为打猎的游戏要杀害众多官吏，愚臣认为不可以。斗胆以死相请！”文帝说：“你是正直的臣子。”于是把他们全部赦免了。然而苏则也因此被文帝忌惮。

passages.en: Cao Pi asked Su Ze, "When we conquered [[Jiuquan|/maps/map-overall?admin=141]] and [[Zhangye|/maps/map-overall?admin=137]], envoys began travelling to and from the Western Regions, and Dunhuang presented a pearl one [[cun|/translations/officials#glossary-cun]] across. Could more be obtained by purchase?" Su Ze replied, "If Your Majesty's transforming influence pervades the realm and your virtue reaches even the deserts, such pearls will come of themselves without being sought. If they must be sought out and purchased, they are not worth prizing." The emperor fell silent. Later, Su Ze accompanied him on a hunt. A stake in the hunting enclosure came loose, allowing a deer to escape. The emperor was furious. Seated on a stool, he drew his sword and ordered all the officers overseeing the hunt arrested for execution. Su Ze knelt and bowed his head to the ground, saying, "I, your servant, have heard that the sage kings of old never harmed men for the sake of beasts. Your Majesty now seeks to exalt the civilising rule of Yao, yet would put numerous officials to death over a hunt. Your foolish servant believes this cannot be allowed. I dare plead for their lives on pain of death." The emperor said, "Sir, you are an upright minister," and pardoned them all. Yet thereafter, the emperor grew wary of Su Ze.

vern.zht: 黃初四年，蘇則被降職爲[[東平|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=37]][[相|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#states-064]]。他還沒有到任，在途中生病去世，諡號爲剛侯。他的兒子蘇怡繼承爵位。蘇怡去世，沒有兒子，他的弟弟蘇愉承襲封爵。蘇愉在咸熙年間擔任[[尚書|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-033]]。
vern.zhs: 黄初四年，苏则被降职为[[东平|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=37]][[相|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#states-064]]。他还没有到任，在途中生病去世，谥号为刚侯。他的儿子苏怡继承爵位。苏怡去世，没有儿子，他的弟弟苏愉承袭封爵。苏愉在咸熙年间担任[[尚书|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-033]]。

passages.en: In the fourth year of Huangchu, Su Ze was [[demoted|/translations/officials#glossary-reassign]] to [[Principality Chancellor|/translations/officials/regional#states-064]] of [[Dongping State|/maps/map-overall?admin=37]]. Before reaching his post, he fell ill and died en route. He was posthumously titled Marquis Gang, the Resolute Marquis. His son Su Yi succeeded him. Su Yi died without a son, so his younger brother Su Yu inherited the fief. During the Xianxi era, Su Yu served as an [[Imperial Secretariat|/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-033]].

vern.zht: 蘇愉字休豫，歷任[[太常|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-120]]、[[光祿大夫|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#civil-honorary-officials-119]]。見於《晉百官名》。山濤的《啓事》中稱讚愉忠誠篤厚且有智謀。臣裴松之考證：蘇愉的兒子紹，字世嗣，擔任吳王的老師。石崇的妻子，是蘇紹的姐姐。蘇紹有詩收錄在《金谷集》中。他弟弟蘇慎，擔任[[左衛將軍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#superior-excellency-002]]。
vern.zhs: 苏愉字休豫，历任[[太常|/zh-hans/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-120]]、[[光禄大夫|/zh-hans/translations/officials/ministers#civil-honorary-officials-119]]。见于《晋百官名》。山涛的《启事》中称赞愉忠诚笃厚且有智谋。臣裴松之考证：苏愉的儿子绍，字世嗣，担任吴王的老师。石崇的妻子，是苏绍的姐姐。苏绍有诗收录在《金谷集》中。他弟弟苏慎，担任[[左卫将军|/zh-hans/translations/officials/ministers#superior-excellency-002]]。

annotations.en: Su Yu, courtesy name Xiuyu, successively served as [[Minister of Ceremonies|/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-120]] and [[Household Counsellor|/translations/officials/ministers#civil-honorary-officials-119]], and is listed in the Official Posts of Jin. In Shan Tao's The Explanation of Matters, Shan Tao praised him as loyal and steadfast, with sound judgement. Your servant Songzi notes that Su Yu's son Su Shao, courtesy name Shisi, served as tutor to the Prince of Wu. Shi Chong's wife was Su Shao's elder sister. Su Shao's poems are in the Jingu Collection. Su Shao's younger brother, Su Shen, was [[General of the Central Guards on the Left|/translations/officials/ministers#superior-excellency-002]].
